standard_prerequisites.use: Blowups of smooth centres and their strict transforms, finite-group torsors and invariant quotients, affine descent, regular-local factoriality, rational equivalence and degree of line bundles on proper cycles.

core_obligations: Build the equivariant two-order blowup of the two conics and pull it back to a projective etale-local family.
Assume an effective scheme quotient, construct a divisor meeting the descended exceptional curve, and contradict degree invariance of the rationally trivial effective cycle.

proof_roadmap.step: Build the equivariant two-order blowup of the two conics and pull it back to a projective etale-local family.
Assume an effective scheme quotient, construct a divisor meeting the descended exceptional curve, and contradict degree invariance of the rationally trivial effective cycle.

difficulty_reason: The counterexample requires coordinating opposite blowup orders with a free involution and then converting a hypothetical scheme neighbourhood into a contradictory divisor degree. The source explicitly supplies the local blowup/rational-equivalence core, so H2 does not rest on merely naming Hironaka.
